messages.subject: Project Drake — confidentiality agreement
messages.plaintextBody:
Oliver,

Ahead of data room access, please find attached the confidentiality agreement for Project Drake for your clients' signature. It is on broadly standard terms — two-year term, 12-month non-solicit. Grateful if you could turn this around so we can get into diligence.

Kind regards,
Elena Marchetti
Associate, Whitfield Carter LLP

—
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
